Rules: output strict JSON conforming to schema.

We have two invariants:
- complete checkout button must never be covered
- revenue series legend must stay visible

We need to create invariants array with two entries.

Each invariant:
id: kebab-case-identifier
description: Clear human-readable statement
type: visual
severity: error
matcher: strategy semantic, target Element name or label, expected true

We need to ensure JSON valid.

{

  "version": "1.0",
  "invariants": [

      "id": "complete-checkout-button-visible",
      "description": "Complete Checkout Button must remain visible and not covered when cart drawer is open",

      "severity": "error",
      "matcher": {

    }
  ]
}
